1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use this when the employee should take home a fixed amount, such as the $500 net at-home office stipend. Oracle grosses it up so the net lands where you set it.

Start from the Quick Action, or search the employee's name and open the action from their record. Both reach the same screen.

Use this whenYou are paying a fixed take-home amount.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Missed the cutoff (around the 18th)? Date it for next month.
  • Only change Process separately if payroll tells you to.
  • Pay goes to direct deposit, which is required.

3 · Knowledge check

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Process a net one-time stipend

Use when: You are paying a fixed take-home amount. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Start the transaction.
    • Quick Actions > Individual Compensation > select the employee, or
    • Search the employee's name > Individual Compensation.
  2. Click Add > One-time or recurring payment.
  3. Plan: Lump sum payment.
  4. Start date: the first day of the payroll month you're targeting (for example, Nov 1 for the November check).
  5. Enter the amount in the Net field (for example, $500).
  6. Leave Process separately set to Yes.
  7. Click Save.
  8. No comments or attachments needed: click Submit. Otherwise click Continue, add them, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Missed the cutoff (around the 18th)? Date it for next month.
  • Only change Process separately if payroll tells you to.
  • Pay goes to direct deposit, which is required.
